title: Palladium-catalyzed dioxygenation of alkenes
protocol: An alkene (0.50 mmol, 1.0 equiv), PhI(OAc)2 (1.2 equiv), and a tridentate palladium complex immobilized on magnetic particles (3.5 mol%) were combined in DMF/AcOH (1:2) under nitrogen. The mixture was stirred at 20 C for 5 h to give the dioxygenated alkene in 86% yield.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.
